content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Lemon squeezy

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack you own outright. It’s not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a combination of free and paid tools deployed on your terms. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. No single point of failure. No platform lock-in. No geographic restrictions. This architecture bypasses the payment processors that exclude you. It’s not a hack—it’s a structural alternative. You control the entire flow, from product display to payment confirmation to file delivery. The system is designed to work in regions where conventional platforms fail. It’s not just for digital creators in Nigeria; it’s for anyone who values infrastructure sovereignty over platform dependence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is modular and composable. Start with hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve your storefront for free. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—both free, both scalable. Orders are stored in Supabase (a free PostgreSQL database) or Google Sheets. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both cost-effective and reliable. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. The moment payment confirms on-chain, a webhook triggers file delivery. The system is stateless and serverless, meaning it scales automatically without additional cost. Each component is independent, so you can swap tools as needed. For example, if you outgrow Google Sheets, migrate to Supabase without rebuilding the stack. This architecture is designed for longevity, not for temporary workarounds.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, and you’ve been locked out of conventional payment processors, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, complete with SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing. You get a fully operational store with five products loaded and 30 days of support. This isn’t a DIY project—it’s a professional deployment. You own everything after delivery. COREMERCH has no access to your stack. No subscriptions. No platform dependence. Just sovereign infrastructure that works where others fail.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership of the entire stack—no platform dependence.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide static hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, such as order processing and webhook handling. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly after payment. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, triggering file delivery via webhook. The system is designed for low-cost operation. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The stack is open and composable. You can inspect every line of code, modify it, or replace components as needed. This transparency is intentional—it’s how you achieve true infrastructure sovereignty. No black boxes. No hidden dependencies. Just tools that work together to give you control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This option deploys the stack in 48 hours, fully configured and tested. If you prefer to build it yourself, purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation and source code. Either way, you’ll own the infrastructure after deployment. No ongoing fees. No platform lock-in. The system is designed to work out of the box, but you can customize it as needed. Add more products, integrate additional tools, or scale the backend—the architecture supports it. This isn’t a temporary solution; it’s a permanent alternative to the platforms that exclude you.
